remarks: Ideally located just steps from the shopping and dining of downtown Westport, with the train station and I-95 only minutes away, this bright, airy two-bedroom home features soaring ceilings and an open, light-filled layout. One bedroom is located on the main level, while the upstairs primary bedroom includes a walk-in closet. The second-floor loft and landing area overlooks the main living space and offers water views, making it an ideal spot for a home office, reading nook, or lounge area. The home may be offered partially furnished as seen, or unfurnished, depending on tenant needs. One covered parking spot with personal tesla charge if needed. Flexible lease terms available, including annual or month-to-month. Listing agent is owner. Contact agent for monthly pricing and additional details
